policy: This manifest records temporary semantic-regex debt outside the new token-driven FSM boundary. It is not permission to add regexes or card-specific branches. Each family leaves this list when its local automata reach semantic and runtime parity.

entries.reason: The legacy routing hint still recognizes several ability families from raw text.
entries.removalCondition: Classification is derived from successful token-driven ability-envelope parsing.

entries.reason: Legacy ability-envelope leaves still include regex-based Oracle patterns.
entries.removalCondition: Activated, triggered, static, replacement, keyword, and spell envelopes consume the shared token stream.

entries.reason: Legacy effect leaves are being replaced family by family by reusable local automata.
entries.removalCondition: Every promoted effect family has zero regex fallback and equivalent primitive IR/runtime coverage.

entries.reason: The legacy condition parser still reconstructs and matches text fragments.
entries.removalCondition: Condition expressions are parsed by the shared condition sub-automaton.

entries.reason: Non-mana legacy cost forms still include regex recognition.
entries.removalCondition: Compound costs are consumed by the shared cost sub-automaton while mana atoms continue to use the engine mana parser.

entries.reason: Legacy target and object criteria contain regex-based qualifier parsing.
entries.removalCondition: Selectors and predicates are produced entirely by the shared selector sub-automaton.

entries.reason: Legacy numeric expressions still use regex captures for several compound forms.
entries.removalCondition: All numeric atoms and operators are handled by the token-driven numeric-expression sub-automaton.

entries.reason: Some legacy value leaves still recognize reconstructed text with regexes.
entries.removalCondition: Value, zone, duration, and color concepts are returned by typed token sub-automata.
